title: Grounding
description: Four minutes to step out of the spiral and come back to where you are. Eyes open.

segments.say: You can keep your eyes open for this practice.
Start by feeling your feet on the floor. The weight of your body on the chair, or on the ground.
Now look around and find five things you can see. No hurry.
Now four things you can touch. Your clothes, the chair, the air on your skin.
Now three sounds. Near or far.
Two smells, if there are any. Or just the air coming in through your nose.
And one taste. Or just the feeling of your mouth.
Notice where you are now. In this place, in this moment.
Your body is here. You are here.
Whenever you like, carry on with your day.
